name: Near Pivot Stocks
description: Stage 2 stocks within 5% of their chart pattern breakout pivot.
sql_template: SELECT id.symbol, o.close, id.pivot_price, id.buy_range_top, id.base_pattern, id.base_length_weeks, id.base_depth_pct, id.base_quality_score, id.stage, id.sniper_score FROM indicators_daily id JOIN ohlcv_daily o ON id.symbol = o.symbol AND id.date = o.date WHERE id.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM indicators_daily) AND id.near_pivot = 1 AND id.stage = 2 AND id.base_pattern != 'none' ORDER BY id.base_quality_score DESC
